status: implemented; short numerical and GPU timing checks in progress; no formal training
method: predicted midpoint coefficients + symmetric automatic discrete gradient + preconditioned Picard + implicit-root backward
contraction_condition: h^2*L_G/(2*lambda_min(A)) < 1 on an invariant neighborhood; PSD D alone is insufficient
fallback: FD Jacobian Newton with Armijo solves SAME predicted-D root; only root failures enter bounded subdivision, each child recomputes coefficients
backward: J^T lambda=dL/dv; dL/dx contribution=-lambda^T partial_x F; qnext,pnext direct terms handled by outer autograd
gradient_checks: root physical residual + chain acceptance; exact AD J at accepted root; finite adjoint, condition<=1e8, linear residual<=1e-10*scale, ||J^-1 F||<=4*physical root scale; first-order outer gradients only
changes: Same learned H/D/B parameters and continuous model
Different discrete map from BOTH predicted D and ADD rather than Gonzalez
IFT approximates converged-root gradient, not finite-iteration program gradient
No future true frames reset autoregressive rollout
limits: Second order assumes smooth branch, O(h^2) predictor accuracy and sufficiently small root/chain defects
Softplus threshold and small secant Taylor branches are explicitly audited
No global uniqueness, convergence or arbitrary-stiffness accuracy guarantee
Predictor failure rejects the step before subdivision

alternative_not_selected: Damping Cayley + Verlet removes nonlinear roots but introduces sign-indefinite conservative-step energy defect; not equivalent to strict original-H dissipation.
